title: LLV-GLF300: linear fan-in, cubic classical space and a one-third time coefficient

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2N), the single LLV-GLF300 configuration in proof.md recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. On EVERY branch charged work is O(2^((1/3)sqrt(n)log2(n))), with an absolute outside constant and exact growth index1/2. For n>=2^4096 compute v=floor(sqrt n),r=ceil(sqrt n),ell=ceil(log2n),lambda=ell,H_n=bit_length(n^1024-1),m=floor(1024*(30v-5120ell)/(20H_n-23552)),kappa=ceil(log2(m+2))+3,A_bar=ceil((n+m*kappa)/(m*lambda))+2,center=ceil((m-1)/2),fan_i=A_bar+i-center. Exact quadratic prefix capacity selects full levels and one final k-input, widthR, one-qubit-output call, with k=ceil((R+kappa+1)/lambda). Dbar=2K*lambda*fan_max*A_bar^m,Dcap=2^12nDbar,Ccap=2^13nDbar. Sections8 and14 prove the source/product bound and deterministic per-level consumed-leaf work, with a negative41/5120sqrt(n) margin and uniform o(sqrt(n)) remainder absorbing all fixed polynomial work factors. All source/extraction, lookup/exclusion, generation, arithmetic, measurements, discarded/failed work and cleanup are charged jointly with all other claims.

For this same LLV-GLF300 configuration, every N,s and EVERY branch, peak classical space is O(n^3) bits, with an absolute outside constant and exact growth index0. With lambda=ceil(log2n),2^lambda<2n. O(n) retained tables each contain O(n^2) bits; only the current merge retains its O(n^2)-bit tuple list. Current input/sort/residue arrays take O(n^(5/2)), and profile/prefix data, source/extraction scratch, parameter/cap arithmetic and streamed decoder data take O(n^3) or less. No full recursion tree or exponential circuit is stored. This is joint with full-secret success and all other claims.

For this same LLV-GLF300 configuration, every N,s and EVERY branch, peak quantum allocation is O(n) qubits, with an absolute constant and exact envelope growth index0. Pending siblings use O(lambda*sum_i fan_i)=O(n), and the single finish and each fresh search use O(fan_max*lambda)=O(sqrt(n)log n) additional reusable scratch. Rank/projection, source transforms, extraction, failed branches and cleanup are included. Section8 bounds the profile sum using m*A_bar*lambda<=n+m*kappa+3m*lambda, jointly with unconditional full-secret success and the other claims.

For this same LLV-GLF300 configuration, every N,s and EVERY branch, all fresh acquired copies number O(2^((3/4)sqrt n)), with an absolute constant and exact growth index1/2. All rejected, discarded, failed and aborted copies count. With Dbar=2K*lambda*fan_max*A_bar^m,Dcap=2^12nDbar,Ccap=2^13nDbar, the literal main cap nCcap+K<=2^((3/4)sqrt n) follows from Section8. The exact centered sum is at most m*A_bar, so AM-GM bounds the full fan-in product by A_bar^m and all prefixes/final arities by fan_max*A_bar^m. H_A=bit_length(A_bar^1024-1) satisfies m*H_A/1024<=(3/4)v-128ell, absorbing the full polynomial cap factors. The finite branch changes only outside constants. This holds jointly with unconditional full-secret success and all other claims.

For the same LLV-GLF300 algorithm and configuration of proof.md, the proved fractional error tolerance is epsilon(n) = 0: all Q source copies are independent ideal coset states. Under this promise, for every N and s, full-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1 - 2^-8 jointly with all four resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance is asserted; this is not a proof that greater tolerance is impossible.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
